name: TestStrip
tagline: A simple build status "override-er" for testing your Greenlight Client.
description: You could check your shiny new client actually goes red by breaking the build on purpose. Your team would love that. Or you could press a button. Five pads and a toggle: LIVE, grey, green, amber, red, and BUILDING for when you want blinking too. Press one and every light Greenlight drives, from the tray icon to the lamps to every attached client, agrees with you, whatever the pipeline thinks. A lie with a very convincing glow. Close the strip and the hold goes with it, so a crashed tester can't leave your light fibbing all afternoon. Reality comes back. It's usually worse.
